references.text: Be watchful, for you do not know on what day your Lord will come
Be dressed and ready with your lamps lit, like servants waiting for their master's return from the wedding feast
Wake up! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous and strong!
So let us not sleep as others do, but let us be awake and sober

Wake up, and strengthen what remains and is about to die. I have not found your works complete before my God. Remember therefore what you received and heard; hold fast to it, and repent! If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come upon you
See, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps their garments, so that they may not go naked and people see their shame
